name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: A part that opens in place and pushes what follows: a quiet DM Sans Medium trigger with a muted chevron that turns, and content that grows to its height and settles in.
use_for: More filters under a search, the rest of a list, details a person asks for. Several questions in a stack are an accordion.
never: A chevron that moves on hover
Animating it when it is toggled from the keyboard
source: Derived from the guidelines: DM Sans Medium labels, muted neutrals for secondary text, the #262626 card fill. shadcn's collapsible for anatomy and ARIA.
